scope: All 15 original entrypoints execute unchanged through complete normal returns. Eleven bounded full APIs compare exact EAX and all 0x1000 actor bytes. Four address-boundary APIs compare exact EAX, ordered read/write address-width-value traces and complete supplied memory cells, with mutations before every memory event. Indexed multiplication and effective addresses wrap in 32 bits; toggle returns object+index*4. Partner pointers are captured before the second read even when the owner pointer then changes. Fixtures include self-partners, high/wrapping object and partner tokens, signed-word comparison edges, full-width indexed parameters and truncated byte writes. Availability errors preserve the output token and stop at the failed boundary. Duplicate projected helpers 43b970/43bd40/418830 retain separate accessor canonical full APIs. Existing global full APIs, compare_unsigned and table_used_count are outside this report.
